{{Quote|I've long been trying to guide Jabba the Hutt away from violence to solve his problems. Any conflicts on Tatooine attract undue attention from Coruscant. Recently, I sent my aide, Belutoo Gezmaani, to Jabba's palace for yet another negotiation. The discussion went&mdash;poorly. Jabba transported my aide as far as the Jundland Wastes, then left him there to fend for himself. Be so kind as to provide him a safe escort back here.|Tour Aryon|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Belutoo Gezmaani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] aide for [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tour Aryon]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNoble.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Belutoo Gezmaani]]
Belutoo Gezmaani was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Belutoo Gezmaani spawned under the generic "noble" template, his appearance was randomized under one of forty-two possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Gezmaani could appear as included [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] under either [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Gezmaani as male, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
